TVK MLA Calls for Closure of Alleged JK Tyres Plant Amid Vijay PM Pitch Controversy

On 3 September 2026, a Tamil Nadu Assembly session saw TVK MLA Tahira demand the shutdown of a JK Tyres facility in Ranipet, alleging that the plant does not exist. The demand was raised on the Assembly floor and was presented as evidence of misinformation from the TVK government. The TVK party, led by actor‑turned‑politician Joseph Vijay, has been promoting Vijay as a possible prime‑ministerial candidate for the 2029 national elections. Congress leader Tharahai Cuthbert publicly rejected the TVK pitch for Vijay as prime minister. Right‑leaning coverage called the MLA’s claim a “false info” incident, blamed Minister Keerthana for allowing the misinformation, and suggested JK Tyres consider legal action for defamation. Centrist outlets focused on the political debate over Vijay’s potential candidacy and noted reactions from various parties without emphasizing the factory claim.
